subject: Re: DFW행 항공운임 견적 요청
body:
Hello,

Our buyer has withdrawn the order, so we have to cancel the shipment. Please do not book it. If you have already booked it, please cancel the booking.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer says the order was withdrawn and asks us not to book, declining the quoted shipment.
